definition: An illusion is a mistaken mental construction that starts from data that are real or reliable in their own sphere, leading a person to accept something as real when it is not. The term can also mean the false mental object produced in this way, and more broadly the mind’s acceptance of what is unreal; in this historical usage it is broader than hallucination because it can include errors beyond simple sense perception.
